sources.title: CANS: Capability-Preserving Neuron Steering for Large Language Models
sources.read_scope: Official abstract and bibliographic metadata only;experimental HTML link did not resolve in this pass.
sources.finding: The abstract describes neuron scaling chosen from target-token and general-distribution proxies with a closed-form solution. This is direct prior work on scaling for behavioral control and capability retention.
sources.constraint: Its fitted coefficients are not adopted here. The human prohibits fitted gains and disguised parameter optimization even when a method is called training-free.
sources.not_claimed: No replication or detailed estimator/appendix audit.

sources.title: Distributed Sparse Interventions in Language Models
sources.finding: The paper combines initial effect ranking with per-neuron intervention scaling and iterative sparse optimization. Its no-iteration comparison also determines a shared gain. It discusses nonlinear effects and open-generation repetition.
sources.constraint: Do not import iterative intervention fitting or search a common gain. A manually prescribed factor2 and fixed coordinates are a narrower non-optimized test,not a general-method novelty claim.
sources.not_claimed: No full appendix replication or transfer of its task scores to Gemma4E2B.
